1339-4506-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-4506-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

277-2577-6797-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
277-2577-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

728-1339-1808-6625.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first and second abilities trigger, causing you to create a Clue token and then to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

141-728-6476.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
141-728-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4488-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4772-6664-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

390-670-1430-1619.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
390-670-1430-1619.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Hulking Metamorph and Mirror Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
390-670-1430-1619.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1308-5184-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

1169-1368-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1169-1368-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

3240-5477-6462-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Insidious Roots triggers, creating a Treasure token, a 1/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2523-2869-5241.description:
Cast Sakashima's Student by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Sakashima's Student into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Sakashima's Student dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Sakashima's Student that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Sakashima's Student token instead.
2523-2869-5241.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with. If able, you can instead use Sakashima's Student's ninjutsu ability.

643-2921-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
643-2921-4302.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2292-5220-6772-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

240-719-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Xenograft, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-719-5231.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

240-4460-5470-6797.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

4571-5702-6753.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4571-5702-6753.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Life // Death
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

250-779-1479-2907-5414.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2907-5414.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Scute Swarm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1170-1329-3464-4211.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Tormod's Crypt.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Hyrax Tower Scout.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3875-5702-6753-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3875-5702-6753-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating two Mutavault land tokens that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner each trigger twice.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 4 or higher

1318-2743-4493.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Irenicus's Vile Duplication twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Irenicus's Vile Duplication spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

539-5412-5649-6517.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3771-4484-4871-5147-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
3771-4484-4871-5147-5643.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
3771-4484-4871-5147-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability and Animar trigger.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Resolve the Geralf trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
3771-4484-4871-5147-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

560-2425-2921-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2425-2921-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Smothering Abomination triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities.
Repeat.

1354-1835-4275-6441.notablePrerequisites: Zaxara does not have summoning sickness.
1354-1835-4275-6441.description:
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying {2}{G}{G}.
Zaxara triggers, creating two 0/0 Hydra creature tokens.
The Hydras enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Faces of the Past trigger twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all Hydras.
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the second Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Hydras.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a 0/0 Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
The Wurm enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the Wurm dies, Faces of the Past triggers, either tapping or untapping all Wurms.
Repeat.

950-4613-6210.easyPrerequisites:
Neerdiv has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Neerdiv, Devious Diver does not have summoning sickness.
950-4613-6210.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
950-4613-6210.description:
Activate a creature using Fatestitcher's ability by tapping it, untapping Neerdiv.
Activate Neerdiv using Fatestitcher's ability by tapping it.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Resolve the Neerdiv ability from step 2, untapping another creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3090-5434-5555-5686.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Harmless Offering.
3090-5434-5555-5686.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 2.

275-1799-4050-5359.description:
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and the Gnomes, adding {4}.
Repeat.

428-804-1077-1694.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Sakashima the Impostor on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
You have enough mana to cast Wrong Turn.
428-804-1077-1694.description:
Cast Wrong Turn by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Sakashima the Impostor.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Sakashima the Impostor triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

222-527-997-1322.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-997-1322.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

813-1987-2103.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1329-1477-1750-2793-5261.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Ugin's Nexus.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

1111-3363.notablePrerequisites: Temporal Adept does not have summoning sickness.
1111-3363.description:
Activate Temporal Adept by paying {U}{U}{U} and tapping it, returning The One Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat each turn.

230-2034-2252-3263.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
230-2034-2252-3263.description:
Activate Necrogenesis by paying {2}, exling a creature card from an opponent's graveyard and creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {2}.
Activate Void Attendant by paying {2} and putting a card from an opponent's exile into their graveyard, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion, adding {2}.
Repeat.

813-1092-1181.description:
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven {B}.
Cast Torrent of Souls by paying {4}{B/R}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning Sacrifice and Torrent of Souls from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

539-3181.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Krosan Restorer does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional land without summoning sickness.
539-3181.description:
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping itself at least one other nonsummoning sick land.
Activate the land, adding {1}.
Repeat.
